bioEn: The most celebrated poet of Urdu, writing in Delhi as the Mughal world ended. Known for wit, philosophical depth, and lines that hold several meanings at once.
A Delhi poet loved for a clear, conversational Urdu. His ghazals are playful, romantic, and easy to say aloud.
The last Mughal emperor and a poet, exiled to Rangoon after 1857. His verses are often read as laments for a lost world.
